description:
YITAMOTOR provides you with the best innovative, quality products & professional services at competitive prices. We are confident that our products will surpass your expectations and make you a happy customer!
Fitment
2014-2018 Chevrolet Silverado 1500
2015-2019 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD 3500HD Double Cab
2014-2018 GMC Sierra 1500
2015-2019 GMC Sierra 2500HD 3500HD Double Cab
2019 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Legacy
2019 GMC Sierra 1500 Limited
Fit Through Console, No Floor Shifter, No Power Take Off;
Does not fit vehicles with vinyl flooring,only for carpet flooring
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Features
Custom Fit: These floor mats are fit for 2014-2018 Silverado/Sierra 1500, 2019 Silverado 1500 Legacy/Sierra 1500 Limited, 2015-2019 2500/3500 HD, Double/Extended Cab Only(NO PTO Kit). 3D laser scanning technology gives full protection to both the front and back. These mats are not for vehicles with vinyl floors. Fits carpet flooring and models without floor-mounted manual 4x4 shifter. Please remove old floor mats before installing new floor liners.
Sturdy & Safe: These odorless floor mats are made from safe, high-density TPE material.The product contains no latex, cadmium, lead, or harmful PVCs, and provides comfort, extreme wear-resistance, and flexibility even in harsh cold
All-Season Protection: Enjoy full protection with our floor liners, featuring anti-slip retainer clips, a textured surface that helps keep cargo from shifting, and raised lip designed to trap liquids, debris, snow, mud, sand, and other elements
Easy Maintenance: Cleaning your chevy silverado / gmc sierra accessories is a breeze; simply remove, shake off, and hose down to achieve a pristine look. No need for vacuuming or harsh chemicals, ensuring a no-hassle maintenance
Why Choose Us: Our floor mats are engineered with advanced technology for tailored protection; Choose YITAMOTOR for reliable, all-weather guard and built-to-last quality

specifications.Special features: Solid, easy to install, easy to clean, precision 3d laser measured, perfect fit, waterproof, anti-slip, durable, non-toxic tpe material, all-weather protection
